capture.action: exact native combat formula method-boundary capture; no player values

methodBoundaryRule: Every analyzed boundary ends at the next unique Assembly-CSharp method pointer and has matching methodPointer and virtualMethodPointer bytes. One method body exceeds the capture byte limit; its exact size and prefix are recorded separately.

normalization.bodySha256: SHA-256 of the complete exact native body, or null for a truncated prefix.
normalization.exactBoundaryDescriptorSha256: SHA-256 of stable method identity, exact start/end/size, and captured-code hash.
normalization.callTargetNormalizedSha256: SHA-256 after replacing each direct BL immediate with opcode 0x94000000.
normalization.fieldAccessRule: Only unsigned-immediate scalar loads/stores whose base is entry register x0 are promoted as direct self-field accesses.

criticalDamage.note: The complete surrounding modifier and rounding chain remains unresolved.

limitations: Resolved direct-call names cover only the sixteen captured exact method starts; other targets remain module offsets.
HunterCtrl.Damaged exceeds the 16,384-byte capture limit; its exact boundary is known but arithmetic/call analysis covers only the captured prefix.
Direct self-field accesses intentionally exclude pointers copied from x0 into other registers.
Arithmetic signatures describe decoded scalar single-precision instructions, not semantic variable names.
No formula is authorized for runtime use until all inputs and golden vectors are independently resolved.
